Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Job description:
 As a Python Automation Engineer at HCLTech, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing robust automation solutions to ensure the quality and reliability of web applications and APIs. Your expertise will contribute directly to HCLTech’s mission of delivering world-class technology products and services, enhancing operational efficiency, and supporting global client engagements. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced automation tools and methodologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive innovation and excellence.
 Responsibilities 
Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test scripts using Python, Robot Framework, and/or Playwright for web applications and APIs.
Design and implement scalable test frameworks and automation strategies to support end-to-end testing requirements.
Integrate automated tests within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring seamless test execution and continuous feedback.
Collaborate with development, QA, and DevOps teams to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve defects and issues.
Track and report defects using industry-standard tools, supporting root cause analysis and resolution.
Contribute to Agile project activities, participating in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Promote and enforce automation best practices across projects and teams, maintaining a quality-first approach.
Communicate effectively with global teams and clients, providing updates, technical guidance, and customer support as needed.
Profile description:
 Requirements 
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in automation testing with Python, Robot Framework, and/or Playwright.
Strong proficiency in Python scripting and test framework design.
Proven expertise in end-to-end automation for web applications and APIs.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.
Familiarity with defect tracking tools and Agile methodologies.
Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Exceptional communication skills, with fluency in spoken and written English.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
 We offer:
 Benefits: 
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform (possibility of choosing flexible benefits like meal tickets, medical coverage for employees and dependents at Regina Maria, private pension, sport subscription, etc.)
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
Eyeglasses cost reimbursement: 1500 RON to be claimed every 3 years
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
